name: Press Metal Aluminium Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Press Metal Aluminium Holdings Berhad 完成以 RM464,952,909.40 收购 PMB Technology Berhad 约 35.6% 股权的交易，该收购于 2026 年 9 月 14 日完成。公司未公告其他业务板块的产能扩张、新业务进入或业务退出事项。
overview_en: In 2026, Press Metal Aluminium Holdings Berhad completed the acquisition of approximately 35.6% equity interest in PMB Technology Berhad for a total cash consideration of RM464,952,909.40, with the acquisition completed on 14 September 2026. No other announcements were made regarding capacity expansion, entry into new businesses, or business exits in other segments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成收购 PMB Technology Berhad 约 35.6% 股权。
segments.note_en: Completed the acquisition of approximately 35.6% equity interest in PMB Technology Berhad this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购 PMB Technology Berhad 约 35.6% 股权的所有先决条件已于 2026 年 9 月 9 日达成，收购于 2026 年 9 月 14 日完成。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent for the acquisition of approximately 35.6% equity interest in PMB Technology Berhad were fulfilled on 9 September 2026, and the acquisition was completed on 14 September 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与卖方签订有条件股份买卖协议，拟以现金 RM464,952,909.40 收购 PMB Technology Berhad 664,218,442 股普通股（约 35.6% 股权）。
actions.text_en: Entered into a conditional share sale agreement with the vendors to acquire 664,218,442 ordinary shares in PMB Technology Berhad (approximately 35.6% equity interest) for a total cash consideration of RM464,952,909.40.
